rows.reply_en:
Hello,

To swap a shift, open the shift in the app and tap "Offer swap". Colleagues with the same role can then accept the swap. If manager approval is enabled, the manager approves the request under Rota → Requests (Rooster → Verzoeken).

Best regards,
Team Roosterly
rows.verified_en: Hello, To swap a shift, open the shift in the app and tap "Ruil aanbieden". Colleagues with the same role can then accept the swap. If manager approval is on, the manager approves the request under Rooster → Verzoeken. Kind regards, Team Roosterly

rows.reply_en:
Hello,

The Plus plan costs €6 per active employee per month (excluding VAT). For 25 active employees, this amounts to €150 per month (excl. VAT).

With the Plus plan, you get access to unlimited locations, API access, and payroll integrations. You can upgrade your subscription at any time under Instellingen → Abonnement (Settings → Subscription). The new price applies from the next invoice.

Best regards,
Team Roosterly
